podcast.body: This was the debut and only album by Plus 44, released on November 13, 2006. The band initially aimed for a more electronic sound, but after various recording attempts, a different style emerged. The album was considered a modest success, receiving some airplay and selling around 300,000 copies worldwide. "The result was an album entitled When Your Heart Stop's Beating that came out on November 13th of 2006."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
